title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,301–4,350 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 地方創生；區域復興振興

examples.en: Regional revitalization programs empower young entrepreneurs to build sustainable hometown businesses.
examples.zh: 國家地方創生政策積極輔導支持返鄉青年創業，在故鄉土地打造具備永續獲利能力的特色事業。

examples.en: The government launched a nationwide fund to support the revitalization of historic railway townships.
examples.zh: 政府設立了專項國家基金，全力支持沒落鐵道舊城鎮的整體風華再現與創生轉型。

examples.en: Cultural events and local festivals play a pivotal role in the economic revitalization of rural areas.
examples.zh: 舉辦多元文化節慶與在地祭典，在帶動偏鄉農村經濟振興與觀光活化方面扮演著關鍵角色。

words.definition: 社區場所營造；地方感塑造

examples.en: Creative placemaking transforms neglected street corners into bustling open-air community gathering hubs.
examples.zh: 導入創意場所營造（Placemaking）理念，將被遺忘的街角老空地翻轉為充滿人情味的社區聚會據點。

examples.en: The team organized collaborative workshops to ensure local placemaking reflected residents' authentic needs.
examples.zh: 規劃團隊主辦多次居民共創工作坊，確保地方場所營造能夠切實呼應在地居民的真實生活需求。

examples.en: Successful placemaking strengthens social bonds and instills a shared sense of belonging among neighbors.
examples.zh: 成功的場所營造能強化鄰里間的情感連結，並在居民心中深植對這片土地的共同歸屬感。

words.definition: 社區充權賦能；賦權 (Empower)

examples.en: Community empowerment inspires residents to co-design neighborhood parks and preserve shared memories.
examples.zh: 推動由下而上的社區營造充權賦能，激勵全體居民攜手共創特色鄰里公園並守護珍貴集體記憶。

examples.en: The non-profit foundation focuses on youth empowerment through hands-on leadership training workshops.
examples.zh: 該非營利公益基金會透過實務領導力培訓工作坊，全心致力於青年返鄉賦權與能力養成。

examples.en: Genuine empowerment happens when citizens gain direct decision-making power over local budget allocations.
examples.zh: 當公民對地方參與式預算的分配擁有真正的實質決策權時，才稱得上是落實真正的社區充權。

words.definition: 農村偏鄉人口外流；人口銳減

examples.en: Revitalization projects tackle rural depopulation by creating digital nomad remote work opportunities.
examples.zh: 地方創生團隊致力於扭轉農村青年人口外流困境，在小鎮積極打造吸引數位遊牧民族進駐的共享基地。

examples.en: Rapid depopulation in agricultural counties has led to the unfortunate closure of several elementary schools.
examples.zh: 農業縣市人口快速外流銳減，導致多所偏鄉迷你小學因缺乏生源而面臨裁併校命運。

examples.en: Affordable housing incentives and modern co-working hubs were established to reverse urban migration depopulation.
examples.zh: 地方政府推出青年平價購屋補貼與現代共享辦公聚落，企圖力挽狂瀾、扭轉人口流失的嚴重頹勢。

words.definition: 地方家鄉自豪感；驕傲

examples.en: Reconnecting with ancestral traditions restores vibrant cultural pride across Hakka mountain villages.
examples.zh: 重新找回祖傳百年民俗技藝與文化根源，為客家山林聚落重新點燃了熱烈而深厚的在地自豪感。

examples.en: Wearing handcrafted aboriginal tribal attire to graduation fills the young scholar with immense pride.
examples.zh: 身著純手工縫製的原住民傳統部落圖騰禮服出席畢業典禮，讓這位年輕學子心中充滿無限驕傲。

examples.en: The restored century-old wooden theater has become the crowning pride of the whole harbor community.
examples.zh: 重新修復啟用的百年全木造老戲院，如今已成為整座漁港聚落最引以為傲的閃耀文化地標。

words.definition: 地方文史敘事力；說故事

examples.en: Compelling brand storytelling connects urban tea drinkers with misty Alishan organic plantations.
examples.zh: 透過打動人心的品牌故事力（Storytelling），將都會品茗愛好者與雲霧繚繞的阿里山有機茶園深刻連結。

examples.en: Authentic storytelling reveals the dedication of multi-generational farming families cultivating heritage rice strains.
examples.zh: 真摯動人的文史敘事記錄了數代農民家族百年守護本土原生米種的心路歷程與堅持。

examples.en: Museums are shifting toward interactive storytelling to make regional archaeology engaging for younger audiences.
examples.zh: 現代博物館逐步導入互動式沉浸敘事手法，讓生硬的在地考古文物與地方文史對年輕世代更具吸引力。

words.definition: 無形的；無形文化資產的

examples.en: Hand-carved puppet theater is officially recognized as priceless national intangible cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 世代相傳的手工布袋戲雕刻木偶與操偶技藝，被正式登錄為國家級彌足珍貴的無形文化資產。

examples.en: Unlike physical monuments, preserving intangible customs requires supporting the master artisans themselves.
examples.zh: 有別於實體古蹟建築，保存無形文化資產的核心在於長遠支持活生生的人間國寶傳承藝師。

examples.en: Oral folk songs and traditional herbal wisdom represent irreplaceable forms of intangible collective heritage.
examples.zh: 口耳相傳的古老民謠歌調與祖傳草藥辨識智慧，代表著不可被替代的珍貴無形集體記憶資產。

words.definition: 傳統工藝師；手作職人大師

examples.en: Master craftspersons spend decades perfecting intricate bamboo-splitting and basket-weaving techniques.
examples.zh: 國寶級傳統竹藝大師耗費數十載青春歲月精益求精，將細緻的劈竹剖篾與立體經緯編織技藝磨練至化境。

examples.en: Each handcrafted clay teapot reflects the unique artistic temperament of the experienced craftsperson.
examples.zh: 每一支手工柴燒紫砂茶壺的線條與溫潤質地，均映照出資深手作陶藝職人獨一無二的藝術氣質。

examples.en: The festival honors veteran craftspersons who dedicate their lifetimes to preserving vanishing folk arts.
examples.zh: 這場工藝盛會隆重表彰並禮遇了畢生奉獻於守護即將失傳民俗手藝的國寶級老工藝師們。

words.definition: 傳統師徒制傳承；學徒期

examples.en: Young designers undertake intensive woodcarving apprenticeships to learn ancestral temple joinery.
examples.zh: 年輕新銳設計師走入傳統三義木雕工坊展開嚴格的三年師徒制修業，潛心學習古老廟宇大木作榫卯技藝。

examples.en: The guild revival program pairs novice smiths with experienced veterans through rigorous four-year apprenticeships.
examples.zh: 工藝協會復興專案推動嚴謹的四年師徒修業制，將熱血青年學徒與身懷絕技的老銅匠進行一對一配對。

examples.en: Through disciplined daily apprenticeship, he mastered the subtle nuances of hand-hammered copper kettles.
examples.zh: 透過日復一日紀律嚴謹的傳統學徒修煉，他終於徹底參透手工鍛打純銅壺的微妙火候與敲擊節奏。

words.definition: 陶瓷工藝；陶藝製品

examples.en: Yingge is globally renowned as Taiwan's ceramics capital, famous for high-temperature celadon glazes.
examples.zh: 新北鶯歌享譽全球「台灣陶瓷之都」美名，以千度高溫柴燒青瓷釉藥與精湛手拉胚茶具聞名於世。

examples.en: Modern tea masters appreciate the earthy textures and unrepeatable ash marks of wood-fired ceramics.
examples.zh: 當代品茶名家無不深深著迷於柴燒陶瓷器皿那質樸原始的粗獷手感與自然落灰熔融結晶。

examples.en: The town's historic ceramics museum exhibits magnificent pottery vessels dating back over two centuries.
examples.zh: 座落於老街旁的鶯歌陶瓷博物館，常年展出兩百多年來台灣製陶歷史與璀璨精湛的代表性古陶器皿。

words.definition: 木雕雕刻藝術；雕塑品

examples.en: Sanyi wood sculpture masters carve fragrant camphor tree roots into lifelike Buddhist statues.
examples.zh: 苗栗三義木雕名匠巧妙順應天然芳香樟木樹根的奇異紋理，以高超刀法雕琢出栩栩如生的莊嚴佛像。

examples.en: The outdoor sculpture park displays monumental bronze installations seamlessly integrated into the landscape.
examples.zh: 戶外雕塑藝術園區展出多件大型現代青銅裝置，與起伏翠綠的自然山丘地景融為一體。

examples.en: She studied classical stone sculpture in Italy before opening her creative studio in rural Miaoli.
examples.zh: 她遠赴義大利佛羅倫斯研習古典大理石雕刻技藝，返台後選擇在純樸的苗栗鄉間設立個人創作工坊。

words.definition: 手工竹編工藝；織布編織

examples.en: Zhushan bamboo weaving merges ancient interlocking geometric patterns with modern lighting design.
examples.zh: 南投竹山竹編工藝將傳承千年的幾何交織編織圖紋，創新融入現代時尚居家吊燈設計之中。

examples.en: Traditional loom weaving requires tremendous focus to thread hundreds of warp strands precisely.
examples.zh: 傳統地機織布需要極高度的專注與耐力，才能將數百根緊密經紗有條不紊地逐一穿引理順。

examples.en: Indigenous elders teach intricate shell-bead textile weaving to young tribal girls during summer vacation.
examples.zh: 部落女性長輩於暑假期間開辦傳承研習班，悉心教導部落少女繁複精美的貝珠衣圖騰織造技藝。

words.definition: 天然三峽藍染；靛藍色

examples.en: Sanxia indigo dyeing uses fermented Assam tea-leaf plants to create deep ocean-blue silk scarves.
examples.zh: 三峽藍染工坊利用大菁植物天然發酵萃取的藍靛染液，親手染製出層次豐富如深邃海洋般的絲巾。

examples.en: The indigo dye vat must be lovingly nourished with rice wine and wood ash to keep the microbes alive.
examples.zh: 照顧藍染發酵缸猶如照顧初生嬰兒，必須定時餵入米酒、木灰水以維持發酵微生物的最佳活性。

examples.en: Visitors folded and bound white fabric with rubber bands before plunging them into the deep indigo vat.
examples.zh: 參與體驗的旅人們用橡皮筋與木片將白棉布巧妙摺疊綁紮，隨後緩緩浸入深邃湛藍的發酵藍染缸中。

words.definition: 傳統天然生漆漆器；漆藝

examples.en: Natural urushi lacquerware requires brushing fifty glossy resin coats over wooden tea bowls.
examples.zh: 純天然生漆漆器（Lacquerware）需要在木胎茶碗上反覆手工塗刷多達五十道天然樹漆並悉心陰乾。

examples.en: High-end lacquerware boasts incredible moisture resistance and a warm, glowing patina that deepens with age.
examples.zh: 頂級天然漆器具備絕佳的防水防腐耐久性，且隨時光推移會散發出日益溫潤深邃的內斂琥珀光澤。

examples.en: The artisan sprinkled genuine gold powder over the wet lacquer surface using traditional maki-e techniques.
examples.zh: 漆藝大師運用古老的蒔繪金銀粉技法，在尚未完全乾燥的濕潤漆面上輕柔灑落細緻如沙的純金金粉。

words.definition: 手工玻璃吹製工藝

examples.en: Hsinchu glassblowing masters shape molten 1,200°C liquid crystal into delicate bubble vases.
examples.zh: 新竹玻璃吹製名師在千度高溫窯爐旁手持吹管，將滾燙晶瑩的熔融玻璃液吹塑成極致空靈的氣泡花瓶。

examples.en: Watching the glassblowing demonstration requires safety goggles due to the blazing thermal radiation.
examples.zh: 現場近距離觀看玻璃手工吹製技藝示範時，必須配戴專業抗高溫護目鏡以抵禦爐火強烈的熱輻射。

examples.en: Studio glassblowing blends technical breath control with spontaneous, fluid artistic expression.
examples.zh: 工坊玻璃手工吹製完美融合了職人精準細膩的氣息吞吐控制，與隨性流動、一氣呵成的即興藝術美感。

words.definition: 傳統刺繡工藝；金線刺繡

examples.en: Master embroiderers stitch glistening golden threads onto silk banners for temple processions.
examples.zh: 鹿港傳統繡莊刺繡名家一針一線將閃耀金線細密縫繡於真絲神明彩布上，展現華麗立體的八仙彩圖騰。

examples.en: The vintage wedding gown featured delicate floral embroidery handcrafted over three hundred hours.
examples.zh: 這件復古華麗手工嫁紗上綴滿繁複典雅的花卉刺繡，耗費了資深繡工整整三百多個小時的心血結晶。

examples.en: Lukang's silk embroidery workshops are revered nationwide for their three-dimensional religious artistry.
examples.zh: 鹿港歷史悠久的八仙彩繡莊工坊，以其精湛絕倫、浮凸立體的立體神明刺繡技藝享譽全台灣。

words.definition: 傳統打錫工藝；白鐵錫器

examples.en: Rare Lukang tinplate artisans hammer pure tin sheets into ceremonial temple candleholders.
examples.zh: 碩果僅存的鹿港萬豐打錫工藝世家，以手工反覆鍛打純錫板，鑄造出莊嚴沉穩的宮廟儀仗錫製燭台。

examples.en: Unlike mass-produced alloys, handcrafted tinplate offerings retain their brilliant silver sheen for generations.
examples.zh: 有別於當代量產的廉價五金合金，全手工敲打淬煉的純錫祭祀神器能歷經數代光陰依然散發溫潤銀光。

examples.en: The master craftsman demonstrated the ancient hammering techniques used to join sheets of tinplate seamlessly.
examples.zh: 打錫老師傅在工作台前親自示範古老的手工鍛造技法，如何嚴絲合縫地將錫片拼焊成立體茶倉。

words.definition: 美濃客家油紙傘；雨傘

examples.en: Hand-painted Meinong oil-paper umbrellas symbolize round perfection, prosperity, and blessings.
examples.zh: 彩繪梅蘭竹菊的美濃客家手工油紙傘圓潤雅緻，在客家文化中寓意圓滿吉祥、多子多孫與平安賜福。

examples.en: The artisan coats tough persimmon glue over the umbrella frame before applying waterproof tung tree oil.
examples.zh: 師傅將堅韌的柿子汁膠均勻塗刷在天然竹製傘骨上，最後再反覆塗上多道具備防水功效的天然桐油。

examples.en: Beyond rain shelter, the oil-paper umbrella is a classic prop in traditional Taiwanese glove puppetry.
examples.zh: 除了作為雨天遮陽避雨的日用品，美濃手工油紙傘更是台灣傳統掌中戲與客家歌舞劇中的經典道具。

words.definition: 花蓮大理石石雕；大理石

examples.en: Hualien sculptors transform raw local marble blocks into modern minimalist home decor pieces.
examples.zh: 花蓮石雕藝術家將花東縱谷開採出的天然堅硬大理石原石，透過精雕細琢蛻變為極簡時尚居家擺飾。

examples.en: Taiwan's east coast is endowed with rich veins of white and jade-green sedimentary marble.
examples.zh: 台灣東海岸蘊藏著得天獨厚的雄偉大理石岩脈，出產紋理純淨的雪白石與色澤溫潤的墨綠蛇紋石。

examples.en: Polished marble coasters and sleek clock faces sell out quickly at boutique lifestyle concept stores.
examples.zh: 表面經精細打磨拋光的大理石杯墊與極簡壁鐘，在都會文創風格概念選物店中總是迅速搶購一空。

words.definition: 手作 DIY 體驗工作坊；車間

examples.en: Tourists flock to hands-on pottery workshops to experience shaping wet clay on spinning wheels.
examples.zh: 週末造訪鶯歌老街的旅人紛紛走進陶藝手作體驗工作坊，在旋轉手拉胚轆轤上感受溫潤陶土的成型魅力。

examples.en: She organized an interactive indigo dyeing workshop for curious neighborhood elementary students.
examples.zh: 她在三峽老街策劃了一場生動好玩的植物藍染體驗工作坊，吸引許多社區小學生熱情參與。

examples.en: The community center hosts weekly carpentry workshops teaching locals how to upcycle discarded wooden crates.
examples.zh: 社區大學每週固定開辦環保木工修繕工作坊，手把手指導地方居民如何將廢棄棧板再造成質感收納家具。

words.definition: 文創聚落樞紐基地；中心軸

examples.en: Historic dockside warehouses were renovated into Pier-2 Art Hub, buzzing with creative makers.
examples.zh: 高雄港邊昔日停泊運糖船隻的歷史碼頭舊倉庫群，如今已華麗轉身為全台最大文創基地「駁二藝術特區」。

examples.en: The renovated brick train station now serves as an active youth incubation and co-working hub.
examples.zh: 昔日閒置的百年紅磚老火車站經過活化修繕，如今搖身一變成為朝氣蓬勃的青年青創孵化共享基地。

examples.en: This vibrant creative hub hosts open mic nights, craft bazaars, and design symposiums year-round.
examples.zh: 這處充滿活力的複合式文創聚落樞紐，一年四季持續舉辦獨立樂團表演、手作市集與設計沙龍講座。

words.definition: 懷舊復古老派的；復古風

examples.en: Old street tea salons feature retro floral armchairs, amber lighting, and vinyl turntable music.
examples.zh: 隱身老街巷弄中的復古茶沙龍擺設著阿嬤時代的懷舊印花扶手椅與琥珀燈光，伴隨黑膠唱片緩緩流淌。

examples.en: Young photographers love capturing portraits with mechanical cameras against retro tiled wall backdrops.
examples.zh: 年輕攝影愛好者特別喜愛手持機械底片相機，以老屋獨特的花磚斑駁牆面為背景拍攝復古人像寫真。

examples.en: The cafe's retro aesthetic pays tribute to the glamorous coffee culture of 1960s downtown Taipei.
examples.zh: 這間網美咖啡廳濃厚的懷舊復古摩登裝潢風格，深情向一九六零年代台北城中咖啡沙龍致敬。

words.definition: 傳統長條街屋 (店屋)；街屋

examples.en: Dihua Street shophouses boast narrow storefronts extending back into multiple light-filled central courtyards.
examples.zh: 大稻埕迪化街長條街屋擁有「進深長、門面窄」的獨特建築格局，內部串聯起多座灑落陽光的天井花園。

examples.en: Preserving the ornate Baroque pediments on historic shophouses requires careful masonry restoration.
examples.zh: 悉心修復保護歷史街屋山牆上繁複精緻的巴洛克洗石子雕花立面，需要高超專業的古蹟泥作匠藝。

examples.en: Ground floors of traditional shophouses hummed with commerce while families resided on the upper floors.
examples.zh: 傳統住商合一街屋的底層一樓作為批發零售店面開門做生意，二三樓則為全家族安居生活的私密空間。

words.definition: 傳統三合院埕斗天井；中庭

examples.en: Generations of families gather under the open courtyard of the brick Sanheyuan during festivals.
examples.zh: 逢年過節全家族老少齊聚在閩南紅磚三合院開闊的門前埕斗（Courtyard）擺設流水席，共享天倫之樂。

examples.en: Cool mountain breezes circulate naturally through the central courtyard, keeping the rooms fresh in summer.
examples.zh: 夏日傍晚清涼的山風在傳統院落的三合院中庭天井間自然對流穿梭，讓各個廂房即便不開冷氣也十分涼爽。

examples.en: We set up banquet tables across the brick courtyard to celebrate Grandma's ninetieth birthday.
examples.zh: 我們在紅磚合院開闊的門埕上擺開數十張總鋪師大紅辦桌，全庄熱鬧歡慶阿嬤的九十大壽。

words.definition: 傳統紅磚窯；陶瓷燒製柴窯

examples.en: The century-old wood-burning snake kiln produces one-of-a-kind pottery with natural ash glaze patterns.
examples.zh: 擁有百年歷史的柴燒蛇窯在長達數日的柴火淬鍊下，窯內高溫落灰在陶器表面自然融成獨一無二的天然灰釉。

examples.en: Firing a traditional brick kiln non-stop for five days demands round-the-clock stoking shifts.
examples.zh: 傳統老磚窯長達五天四夜的連續柴燒淬煉過程，需要全體師徒日夜輪班不斷投柴維持千度窯火。

examples.en: Master potters read flame colors inside the observation hole of the kiln to judge internal temperatures.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的製陶大師僅憑雙眼緊盯觀火孔中熊熊火焰的微妙色澤變化，便能精準判斷窯內的升溫狀態。

words.definition: 台灣老鐵花窗；格柵護欄

examples.en: Nostalgic floral iron window grilles showcase bending craftsmanship found only in vintage Taiwanese homes.
examples.zh: 充滿溫度的台灣老鐵花窗手工彎折出富士山、櫻花與幾何菱格線條，是早期建築最具代表性的鐵工藝美學。

examples.en: Salvaged decorative iron grilles are now repurposed into charming headboards and wall art.
examples.zh: 拆除老屋時被搶救下來的古董鐵花窗，如今被文創設計師重新改造成極富韻味的床頭架與牆面掛飾。

examples.en: The blacksmith hand-bent solid iron bars into exquisite plum blossom window grille silhouettes.
examples.zh: 老師傅在打鐵砧上純手工敲打加熱的實心鐵條，彎折出象徵堅毅高雅的梅花形鐵花窗經典輪廓。

words.definition: 台灣百年古董花磚 (馬約利卡花磚)

examples.en: Restored majolica tiles with vibrant pomegranate motifs symbolize wealth and abundant offspring.
examples.zh: 嘉義花磚博物館用心修復的百年古董立體彩釉馬約利卡花磚，上頭象徵多子多孫的石榴圖騰鮮麗奪目。

examples.en: Historic timber residences across Chiayi were adorned with imported glazed majolica tiles along their facades.
examples.zh: 嘉義許多歷史悠久的珍貴檜木日式民居外牆屋簷下，早期皆鑲嵌著自海外引進的立體彩釉磁磚。

examples.en: Volunteers painstakingly cleaned grease off century-old tiles salvaged from demolition sites.
examples.zh: 文史志工們耗費數週耐心使用特殊溶劑，仔細清除從老屋拆除工地上搶救回來的珍貴古董花磚油垢。

words.definition: 地方代表性特產伴手禮；專業

examples.en: Sun cakes from Taichung and ox-tongue biscuits from Yilan are famous local regional specialties.
examples.zh: 台中外皮酥脆層層分明的奶油太陽餅與宜蘭薄脆香甜的牛舌餅，皆是享譽全台的經典地方特色伴手禮。

examples.en: Every tourist town showcases its own agricultural specialty, from Dahu strawberries to Guanmiao pineapples.
examples.zh: 台灣每一座觀光鄉鎮皆擁有引以為傲的當季在地農特產，從苗栗大湖草莓到台南關廟金鑽鳳梨各具特色。

examples.en: The gift shop exclusively stocks certified organic food specialties packaged in biodegradable wrappers.
examples.zh: 這間在地選物伴手禮專賣店堅持只販售通過產銷履歷認證的優質農產，並採用全生物可分解包裝。

words.definition: 文創質感包裝設計；包裝

examples.en: Eco-friendly bamboo pulp packaging turns humble sun-dried noodles into an upscale culinary gift.
examples.zh: 採用天然環保竹漿紙材精心設計的文創包裝，將純樸日曬關廟麵搖身一變打造為頂級精緻的伴手禮盒。

examples.en: Minimalist packaging with embossed calligraphy elevated the local tea brand into luxury department stores.
examples.zh: 融入燙金書法線條的極簡現代包裝設計，讓在地歷史茶農品牌成功打入頂級精品百貨專櫃。

examples.en: Designers eliminated single-use plastics from the fruit packaging, winning international sustainability awards.
examples.zh: 設計師徹底捨棄一次性塑料，為在地高山鮮果打造全紙質抗震包裝，榮獲多項國際永續設計大獎。

words.definition: 快閃文創選物店；突發的

examples.en: Independent illustrators showcase handmade postcards at seasonal weekend pop-up craft markets.
examples.zh: 眾多獨立插畫家與手作職人每逢週末齊聚四四南村快閃市集，熱情展售親手繪製的限量原創明信片。

examples.en: A temporary pop-up cafe opened in the historic courtyard, serving pour-over coffee for one weekend only.
examples.zh: 一間結合古蹟空間的快閃咖啡館在三合院內限期登場，僅在週末兩天快閃供應手沖單品阿里山咖啡。

examples.en: Brand incubators launch pop-up boutiques inside subway stations to test consumer response before signing leases.
examples.zh: 品牌孵化器在人潮如織的捷運連通道內開設快閃概念店，在簽署長期店租前先精準測試市場受歡迎度。

words.definition: 獨立手作創作者；製造者

examples.en: The grassroots maker movement empowers youth to craft leather goods and scented candles locally.
examples.zh: 席捲全台的文創創客浪潮激勵了無數年輕人投入手作植鞣皮革雕刻與天然大豆香氛蠟燭的獨立品牌創作。

examples.en: Creative makers share laser cutters, 3D printers, and industrial sewing equipment in the community lab.
examples.zh: 在地青年自造者與創客們在共享創客空間中，自由分享使用雷射切割機、3D 列印機與重型工業縫紉機。

examples.en: Buying directly from an independent maker supports small-scale craft livelihoods in small towns.
examples.zh: 跳過批發中介直接向獨立手作創客購買原創藝品，能最直接有力地實質支持偏鄉小鎮的青年職人生活。

words.definition: 藝術家駐村進駐計畫；居住

examples.en: An international artist-in-residence program invites sculptors to create site-specific installations in rural Taitung.
examples.zh: 台東池上國際藝術家駐村計畫每年邀請全球雕塑家深入縱走田野，創作與在地稻浪地景對話的裝置藝術。

examples.en: During her two-month residency, the Japanese painter hosted community watercolor workshops for elementary students.
examples.zh: 在長達兩個月的駐村進駐創作期間，這位日本畫家每週末為在地偏鄉小學生開辦溫馨的美術水彩工作坊。

examples.en: The residency provides lodging, studio space, and material stipends in exchange for cultural contributions.
examples.zh: 這項地方創生駐村進駐專案免費提供舒適宿所、專屬工作室與材料津貼，回饋以豐富多元的在地藝文互動。

words.definition: 平溪天燈；燈籠；提燈

examples.en: Thousands of illuminated sky lanterns rise into the night sky over Pingxi carrying heartfelt wishes.
examples.zh: 數以萬計寫滿祝福願望的溫暖火光平溪天燈在夜空中冉冉升起，照亮元宵夜空，場面壯麗如夢似幻。

examples.en: Traditional paper lanterns painted with auspicious calligraphy hang from the eaves of the ancient temple.
examples.zh: 題寫著吉祥祈福書法的古老手繪紅紙燈籠，整齊高掛在香火鼎盛的百年媽祖古廟屋簷飛簷之下。

examples.en: Children carry glowing animal-shaped LED lanterns through neighborhood streets during the Lantern Festival.
examples.zh: 每逢元宵節慶元宵夜，孩子們手提著造型逗趣可愛的發光生肖小提燈，在社區街頭巷尾歡樂踩街遊行。

words.definition: 台南鹽水蜂炮盛典；煙火

examples.en: Thrill-seekers in protective helmets brave the deafening explosions of Yanshui beehive fireworks.
examples.zh: 全副武裝頭戴全罩式安全帽的熱血信眾湧入台南鹽水，勇敢置身萬炮齊發、震撼耳膜的蜂炮洗禮之中。

examples.en: Millions of miniature rocket fireworks burst simultaneously from giant multi-tiered launch wooden towers.
examples.zh: 數百萬發裝載特製火藥的排炮沖天炮從高聳的木製蜂巢炮城中萬箭齊發，劃破黑夜化作漫天火光。

examples.en: Spectators don thick cotton jackets and sealed fireproof suits before entering the beehive fireworks plaza.
examples.zh: 所有現場參與震撼體驗的圍觀遊客在踏入蜂炮射程前，皆必須穿妥密不透風的厚棉外套與全套防火衣。

words.definition: 媽祖徒步進香遶境；朝聖之旅

examples.en: The 400-kilometer Baishatun Mazu walking pilgrimage draws hundreds of thousands of faithful devotees.
examples.zh: 歷時九天八夜、行程飄忽不定的白沙屯媽祖徒步進香遶境，每年吸引數十萬虔誠信眾徒步跟隨粉紅超跑。

examples.en: Blistered feet and pouring rain never dampen the spirits of pilgrims marching day and night.
examples.zh: 儘管腳底磨出水泡且沿途遭遇暴雨泥濘，也絲毫無法動搖香燈腳信徒們日夜兼程、虔誠伴行的堅毅意志。

examples.en: Generous villagers set up roadside relief stations providing free watermelon, tea, and foot massages along the pilgrimage route.
examples.zh: 沿線熱情的在地村民自發在路邊搭建愛心補給站，免費供應冰鎮西瓜、青草茶並為信徒進行推拿舒緩。

words.definition: 台灣原住民族的；在地的

examples.en: Taiwan's sixteen officially recognized indigenous tribes preserve profound music, carving, and textile traditions.
examples.zh: 台灣法定十六個原住民族群各自保存著深邃動人的複音歌謠、精湛木雕工藝與繁複美麗的圖騰織布文化。

examples.en: The harvest festival is an essential gathering for indigenous families to express gratitude to nature.
examples.zh: 每年盛大舉辦的原住民族年祭與豐年祭，是各部落家族成員向山林海洋天地與祖靈獻上敬畏感恩的核心盛典。

examples.en: Tribal schools emphasize revitalizing indigenous mother tongues to prevent dialect extinction.
examples.zh: 部落原住民實驗小學致力於推展族語沉浸式母語教學，全力防止珍貴的原住民族瀕危方言徹底消失。

words.definition: 泰雅族織布苧麻纖維；天然苧麻

examples.en: Atayal women extract natural ramie fibers from plants to weave durable traditional garments.
examples.zh: 泰雅族織女長輩親手採集山林野生苧麻植物剝皮刮麻、搓線捻紗，織就質地堅韌無比的傳統祖靈圖騰服飾。

examples.en: Harvesting and scraping tough ramie stems is a labor-intensive ritual passed down through matrilineal lines.
examples.zh: 在深山收割野生苧麻並利用竹刀反覆手工刮皮取纖，是母系家族長輩傳授給少女的極耗體力之成年洗禮。

examples.en: Plant-dyed ramie threads retain their vivid earthy colors for generations without fading in sunlight.
examples.zh: 經天然植物汁液浸染的天然苧麻紗線具備極強的抗拉強度，即便長年曝曬日照下也依舊色澤古樸不褪。

words.definition: 排灣族琉璃珠；珠子

examples.en: Paiwan glazed glass beads embody ancestral blessings, with unique patterns representing warriors and noble status.
examples.zh: 排灣族七彩琉璃珠蘊含著祖靈神聖祝福，每種色彩圖騰各自象徵著守護勇士、尊榮貴族與純潔愛情。

examples.en: The bride wore heirloom necklaces strung with rare multicolored beads denoting noble chieftain bloodlines.
examples.zh: 排灣頭目婚禮上的部落新娘佩戴著數串祖傳的彩虹琉璃珠長項鍊，彰顯其無可取代的尊榮頭目世襲血統。

examples.en: Contemporary indigenous jewelers craft wearable modern bracelets featuring miniature hand-fired beads.
examples.zh: 當代原住民珠寶文創設計師將傳統手工火烤微型琉璃珠重新編排，打造出符合現代日常穿搭的時尚手鍊。

words.definition: 魯凱族百步蛇木雕圖騰；圖騰

examples.en: Intricate hundred-pacer snake totems guard the doorways of traditional slate stone slab houses.
examples.zh: 象徵部落守護神與頭目尊榮的百步蛇與百合花圖騰，威嚴雕刻在魯凱族傳統板岩石板屋的門楣柱頭上。

examples.en: The sacred diamond-shaped totem emblazoned on the woven fabric represents the vigilant eyes of ancestral spirits.
examples.zh: 織錦布面上繁複繡製的菱形守護圖騰，在泰雅與太魯閣文化中象徵著祖靈那雙永不合眼的照護凝視之眼。

examples.en: Tribal artists carve geometric totems into cedar pillars supporting the council meeting hall.
examples.zh: 部落工藝大師在支撐青年集會所重達數噸的台灣紅檜大樑巨柱上，親手雕鑿下一圈圈古老而神聖的部落圖騰。

words.definition: 口述的；口頭的；口腔的

examples.en: Recording elders' oral history interviews preserves forgotten village folklore for future generations.
examples.zh: 地方文史工作者帶著錄音設備挨家挨戶採集耆老口述歷史，用心記錄即將在歲月中被遺忘的鄉土傳奇。

examples.en: The tribe's creation myths and ancient migrations were handed down solely through oral storytelling traditions.
examples.zh: 許多台灣原住民族群宏大的創世神話與千百年跨島大遷徙史詩，過去純粹透過祖輩口耳相傳的口述傳統延續。

examples.en: Linguistic scholars documented disappearing oral dialects before the last native speakers passed away.
examples.zh: 語言學家們快馬加鞭趕往部落深山採集瀕危的口述母語錄音，搶在最後幾位母語耆老離世前保留第一手語料。

words.definition: 地方文史田野調查；實地考察

examples.en: Anthropology students conducted intensive ethnographic fieldwork in mountain indigenous communities.
examples.zh: 人類學系師生深入花東偏遠山地原鄉部落展開為期半年的實地民族誌田野調查，採集母語童謠。

examples.en: Conducting respectful fieldwork requires immersing oneself in village life, sharing chores, and learning customs.
examples.zh: 進行具備學術倫理與尊重的田野調查，需要研究者長期彎下腰走入部落生活、共同參與農忙並敬重風俗。

examples.en: The botanist published groundbreaking fieldwork regarding the distribution of rare alpine ferns across the central ridge.
examples.zh: 植物學者發表了扎實的高山野外田野調查專著，全面梳理了中央山脈稜線周遭特有種高山蕨類的生態分布。

words.definition: 文化資產資源盤點地圖化；繪圖

examples.en: Cultural asset mapping cataloged forty historic wells, old trees, and temples across the township.
examples.zh: 透過全鄉文化資產地圖盤點計畫，逐一建檔標註了散落在鄉間各處的四十座百年古井、老神木與歷史古廟。

examples.en: Community mapping workshops invite children to draw neighborhood safe routes and treasured secret hideouts.
examples.zh: 社區資源盤點地圖工作坊邀請在地孩童一同提筆，畫出心中的放學安全散步地圖與私房秘密基地。

examples.en: GIS-based resource mapping assists town planners in identifying underutilized heritage properties ripe for renovation.
examples.zh: 結合地理資訊系統（GIS）的文資盤點地圖，能精準協助城鄉規劃師盤整清查適合轉型修復的閒置老建築。

words.definition: 文化傳承長久性；長壽

examples.en: Passing ancestral knowledge to younger generations guarantees the cultural longevity of traditional crafts.
examples.zh: 將先民智慧與職人手藝薪火相傳給下一代熱血青年，是確保台灣傳統工藝文化長久延續的關鍵。

examples.en: Preserving ancient architectural woodwork requires regular maintenance to ensure historic structural longevity.
examples.zh: 珍貴古蹟歷史建築木結構的妥善保存，仰賴細心定期的防蟲防腐修繕，以確保其跨越百年的結構耐久性。

examples.en: Clean mountain air and organic locally grown sweet potatoes are credited for the remarkable longevity of village elders.
examples.zh: 純淨甘甜的深山山嵐空氣、純淨活水與自家栽種的無毒地瓜，被視為此地長壽村耆老百歲人生的長壽秘訣。

words.definition: 群眾募資平台支持創生；眾籌

examples.en: A successful crowdfunding campaign raised two million dollars to restore the dilapidated Japanese dormitory.
examples.zh: 一場打動人心的線上群眾募資專案在一個月內募得兩百萬元，成功將荒廢的日式木造老宿舍活化修復。

examples.en: Cultural heritage teams turn to online crowdfunding to bypass slow municipal bureaucratic funding cycles.
examples.zh: 文資搶救團隊往往透過公開網路群眾募資平台發起倡議，突破政府公共預算冗長緩慢的行政審核程序。

examples.en: Enthusiastic backers received miniature engraved roof tiles as commemorative rewards for their crowdfunding support.
examples.zh: 每一位出資贊助老屋修復的熱血網友，皆獲得了一塊以老屋原拆紅瓦精心雷射雕刻的手工紀念磚瓦回饋禮。

words.definition: 地方文史導覽解說員；導賞員

examples.en: Knowledgeable volunteer docents lead fascinating walking tours through Lukang's curving alleyways.
examples.zh: 滿腹經綸的在地文史導覽解說員帶領遊客穿梭於鹿港九曲巷與摸乳巷之間，娓娓道來百年風華往事。

examples.en: The museum docent patiently explained the mythological symbolism depicted on the temple's carved roof ridge.
examples.zh: 博物館常設展專業導覽員用深入淺出的話語，為旅人娓娓拆解百年老廟剪黏屋脊上代表忠孝節義的典故。

examples.en: High school students were trained as bilingual docents to guide foreign visitors through the town festival.
examples.zh: 在地高中文史社團學生接受全套雙語導覽培訓，在國際觀光節慶期間自信地為各國外賓提供英文景點解說。

words.definition: 慢遊漫步；巷弄走讀；散步

examples.en: Visitors enjoy a leisurely evening stroll along Tainan's lantern-lit Shennong Street.
examples.zh: 暮色降臨時分，旅人們最愛在紅燈籠高高掛起的台南神農街古色古香石板路上悠閒慢步走讀。

examples.en: Taking a quiet morning stroll through the mist-covered bamboo forest clears the mind effortlessly.
examples.zh: 清晨在雲霧氤氳、晨露微涼的南投竹海幽徑中安靜散步漫遊，能瞬間洗滌都會生活中所有的繁雜心緒。

examples.en: We took a relaxing stroll around the tranquil harbor, watching fishing boats dock with their daily catch.
examples.zh: 我們迎著夕陽餘暉沿著寧靜港灣緩步散步漫遊，愜意看著一艘艘滿載漁獲歸來的近海漁船緩緩靠岸泊錨。

words.definition: 戶外地景裝置藝術；安裝設施

examples.en: Large-scale woven bamboo art installations dot the scenic golden rice fields of Chishang.
examples.zh: 由台東在地藝術家以巨型編織竹藝打造的戶外大型地景裝置藝術，矗立在池上金黃稻浪間格外耀眼。

examples.en: The temporary light installation projected historical village photographs onto old grain silos during the festival.
examples.zh: 在地藝術節期間，藝術團隊利用光影裝置藝術將這座老糖廠斑駁的巨大水泥穀倉轉化為震撼的文史投影光雕。

examples.en: Wind-powered kinetic installations along the coastline chime musically whenever sea breezes pass through.
examples.zh: 沿著海濱步道架設的風動動態裝置藝術，每當太平洋海風輕拂拂過時便會自然發出如風鈴般的悅耳共鳴。

words.definition: 新舊文化共生共榮；共生關係

examples.en: The town achieved a harmonious symbiosis between ancient temple traditions and modern tech startups.
examples.zh: 這座歷史名鎮成功實現了古老宮廟民俗傳統與現代新創科技咖啡館之間互利共存的和諧共生共榮。

examples.en: Coral reefs and photosynthetic algae exist in a fragile, mutually beneficial marine symbiosis.
examples.zh: 絢麗的熱帶珊瑚礁與微小的共生藻在海洋生態系統中維持著細緻平衡、相互依存的互利共生關係。

examples.en: Modern urban planners seek a fruitful symbiosis between bustling commerce and tranquil green parks.
examples.zh: 當代都市規劃大師戮力追求在高密度繁榮商業大街與大片靜謐綠意公園綠地之間，達成有機的雙贏共生。

words.definition: 和平共處；新舊共融共存

examples.en: Historical preservation and modern urban development can achieve respectful coexistence.
examples.zh: 歷史建築文化資產保存與現代都市繁榮發展並非零和對立，而是能透過前瞻規劃達成尊重與共存。

examples.en: The cultural policy promotes peaceful coexistence and mutual respect among diverse ethnic groups.
examples.zh: 台灣多元進步的文化政策大力提倡各族群間的和平共處與彼此尊重，綻放多元包容的璀璨文明色彩。

examples.en: Strict building zoning laws allow the coexistence of quiet family neighborhoods and lively boutique corridors.
examples.zh: 透過明智合理的都市分區都市計畫規劃，成功使靜謐清幽的高品質住宅社區與活潑時尚的文創街區和諧共處。

words.definition: 珍貴文化遺產傳承；遺贈

examples.en: We are proud custodians of this rich cultural legacy, nurturing it for future generations.
examples.zh: 我們每一個人都是這片土地豐厚文化遺產（Legacy）的守護者，有責任讓這份璀璨光芒世代傳承。

examples.en: The master craftsman left an enduring legacy of exquisite ceramic art appreciated worldwide.
examples.zh: 這位國寶級陶藝宗師畢生留下了浩瀚璀璨的陶瓷藝術經典傑作，成為舉世讚譽的永恆傳世遺產。

examples.en: Preserving ancestral agricultural techniques honors the hard-working legacy of Taiwanese pioneer farmers.
examples.zh: 用心搶救保存古老水梯田農耕智慧與原生穀種，正是對百年前胼手胝足開墾這片土地的台灣先祖最深沉的致敬。
